paragraphs: Chapter 1141
Episode 259. The Truth of the World, Your Truth, My Truth (10)
Jin glared at Octavia and clenched his fist. Though she had a youthful appearance like Kelliark, the person who had stepped out of the dimensional gate was undoubtedly Octavia Zipple.
He had no strength left in his body, so his fist wouldn't clench. Now, Octavia could easily take his life with just a flick of her finger.
She could have crushed the entire Vamel Alliance. Currently, there was not a single person left in the Alliance who could fight Octavia.
Step, step, step...
She slowly walked towards Jin, then bent down midway to pick up a staff that had fallen to the ground.
It was the staff Kelliark had dropped, the Origin Stone.
Stopping her steps, she fixed a blank gaze on the staff for a long while. The staff vibrated in her hand, slowly emitting magic.
It was as if it were screaming at her to kill the enemies, to avenge Kelliark.
"To want to change the unchangeable..."
Octavia gripped the staff tighter with a complicated expression.
-Now you can believe all the stories I've told you. The multiverse, the endless war of all dimensions, and so on.
-If so, then survive in this world.
-Pardon?

-While eliminating and conquering countless dimensions, I occasionally noticed things that never change. Strangely enough. One of them is you, Octavia. In all the worlds I knew, you never once survived.
The words Kelliark had spoken after saving her came to mind.
"My lord, you have succeeded. Even though the world and the Zipples have all been destroyed, I have survived like this."
"Octavia Zipple... Keuk."
Jin barely managed to get up before falling forward. The sword just hadn't slipped from his grasp. It couldn't be said that he was holding it.
The moment Jin thought that the only remaining hope was Elona's sun energy, he could see Octavia, who had approached him in an instant, bending her body.
It looked as if she was about to strike Jin down with the staff.
Veradin, who had just opened his eyes, screamed at the sight.
"Aunt! Stop...!"
"Lower your voice. I'm not trying to kill him."
"Huh?"
"By the way, you recognized me right away even though my appearance has become much younger, Veradin."
Octavia's staff, the Origin Stone, stopped, lightly touching Jin's body. And she shared a part of her true energy with Jin through the staff.
Jin got up again and stood facing Octavia.
"What... are you thinking, Octavia?"
Right now, if Octavia wanted to, she could not only massacre the Vamel Alliance but also rebuild the Demon Army. Since she had the completed Origin Stone.
"I was a member of the Zipple clan, not the Demon Army. We were defeated by you before the Demon Army came."
As she spoke, she looked back on her past life.
The gray area.
Under the pretext of being for the Zipples, it was just days of standing in the gray area, turning away from her uncomfortable and painful feelings.
Such a person as herself could not dare to defeat them with force now.
She could not ruin what these shining people had fought to the end to protect.
"I have come to surrender, Jin Runcandel."
"What...?"

"I'm tired now. Of fighting, of the family, and of myself. I have a power stronger than ever before, and a better opportunity than ever is before my eyes, but... I'm tired. This isn't the world I knew. It's even less the world I wanted."
The multiverse, the Demon Army, and the 677th dimension that had met its ruin. Like everyone who had lived in this world, to Octavia, all of those were unfamiliar and terrible things.
"...So, Ancestor, please stop being wary and come out."
As Octavia said that, the center of the sun energy parted to both sides, and a person revealed herself.
It was Elona Zipple.
"Lady Elona...!"
"Lady Elona!"
Jin and Veradin shouted. Elona was in her human form, not the form she had awakened into as Malugia.
"Hand over the Origin Stone to me."
Elona said, closing the distance with Octavia in an instant. Octavia obediently handed the Origin Stone to Elona's outstretched hand.
Only after seeing the Origin Stone pass to Elona could Jin feel at ease. Malugia's will would not consume her again.
"Octavia Zipple, even if you do this, you... no, we cannot be forgiven."
Tzzzt, pok!
Suddenly, a small explosion occurred at Octavia's wrists and ankles. A clot of crimson blood poured from her mouth.
It wasn't Elona who had done it. Octavia had caused a reverse flow herself and disabled her limbs so that she could no longer use magic.
"Hoo, I know."
"But for not doing something foolish now, as a single Zipple... I will express my gratitude. You are the second-best Zipple I have seen while living as a slave of the family."
"The first must be Veradin. Haha, but he is a child who should not be compared to me."
"The fact that this final moment, where I can exist as a person, think as a person, is not filled with battle and murder, is also a relief..."
Elona turned her body and looked at Veradin.
The one and only Zipple who had not treated her as a slave, who had not feared or loathed her, was letting out a sigh of relief.
In her life, which had been nothing but destruction and massacre, Veradin had been a single ray of light. He was the only light she had ever touched directly.
"Lord Jin, I have a favor to ask."
"Lady Elona?"
"The Zipples have committed unforgivable acts for a long time. The fact that Octavia has admitted defeat now, and what I am about to do from now on... cannot be taken into consideration."
Elona did not take her eyes off Veradin. Her narrow, trembling shoulders. Jin, looking at her back, felt he knew what she was going to say.
"Nevertheless, I want to be shameless and greedy just once. Veradin Zipple. Please, Lord Jin, help my Veradin to live on in this world from now on."
As Elona extended her hand, Veradin's body floated into the air. He was soon wrapped in her embrace. Veradin caressed Elona's crying face.

"Lady Elona, it seems you will be leaving soon. Jin is the kind of guy who will do that even if you don't ask. Of course, what we've done can't be forgiven, but still, we have to live to atone for our sins, even a little. I will atone as far as I can, until I die, so let's think more pleasant thoughts at the end."
Elona, still holding Veradin, turned back to look at Jin.
"Well, it's a bit embarrassing to see a friend while being held like this. But Jin, you'll have to understand. This is the last time I'll be able to be like this with Lady Elona."
"Yes... of course."
"Lord Jin, I will now restore the world."
"The world... did you say you would restore it?"
Elona nodded.
Soon, as she lightly struck the ground with the Origin Stone, golden curves spread out in all directions from the sun energy placed in the distance. The light was seen seeping into all the fallen.
"Huh, heok!"
"Kelliark is...!"
"Suddenly, I feel strength in my body...?"
"Did we... win!?"

The sun energy spread by Elona was rapidly restoring the energy of the survivors. Since there were almost no one who had watched the battle with Kelliark to the end, the people who had regained consciousness were looking around frantically to grasp the situation.
The battle is over!
Jin's thunderous voice echoed across the battlefield.
The battle is over, the battle is over, the battle is over. As if his throat would burst, Jin repeatedly shouted the same words.
Unlike a normal battlefield, no cheers were heard.
Instead, the people, with wide eyes, walked towards the direction from which Jin's voice was heard. They ran frantically.

One by one, they could see Jin standing there. Only after seeing Jin with their own two eyes, only after confirming for themselves that he had shouted without a doubt, did the people collapse and burst into tears.
Even though the whole world had been destroyed and countless people had died, they had protected it. The battle was truly over.
And now, Elona was saying that she would restore the world.
"The Origin Stone, the authority of the Sun God Kinzelo. And with the light you left behind... and the sacrifice of a few, including myself, the world can be brought back."
"Is that really possible...?"

"Yes. Not only will the broken lands be brought back, but the dead will also return. Fundamentally, there are similarities to what Kelliark Zipple was trying to do. It's just that my desire is different from his. I want the world to be beautiful. A world with no monsters like me, no such cruel battles... a world with no gods who try to handle people, life, as they please, no Origin Stone, and therefore, a world with no error of the multiverse."
Elona had the full authority of the Sun God and the Origin Stone.

She could achieve whatever she wanted, just like Kelliark. Just like Octavia before she had handed over the Origin Stone, she could do anything if she just put her mind to it. So she chose to restore the world.
As a 'Sun God', she decided to reconstruct the destroyed world and help it be maintained.
As a person, she decided to love the world.

"Lord Jin, I have killed many people against my will. By manipulation, and by my essence as Malugia... but now, as a whole person, I want to save people. And I also have a bad desire to live on and atone for my sins with Veradin forever, but I will not do such a thing. I am a monster, but still, I am a better monster than Kelliark Zipple."
"Is that such a bad thing?"
"It's a terrible thing, Veradin. That is not restoration, but manipulation."
"Yes, it is a bad thing... I can't ask Lady Elona to do such a thing again."
"Lady Elona, if you mean that a sacrifice is needed... whatever it is, if it's possible, I will do it too."
At those words, Elona shook her head.
"Lord Jin cannot do it. Even if it were possible, your people would not let you. The sacrifice is the share of beings like me, who were called gods... and of the light."
Saying so, Elona raised her head and looked up at the sky, which had suddenly begun to darken. It was Helluram.
